data.raw_text: CEO tapos ang pilot episode ay stuck sya sa traffic in his car under the scorching heat of Manila traffic with his prada shades and button down white polo. Masisiraan sya and cool girl Ashtine who’s jack of all trades in a motorcycle will approach him. And their story begins.
